sloka: कथंचिदुपकारेण कृतेनै केन तुष्यति ।न स्मरत्यपकाराणां शतमप्यात्मवत्तया ॥२-१-११॥
transliteration: kathaṁcidupakāreṇa kṛtenai kena tuṣyati ।na smaratyapakārāṇāṁ śatamapyātmavattayā ॥2-1-11॥

translations.english: Gifted with selfrestraint, Rama was pleased even with a single benefit done somehow to him, yet did not remember even a hundred offences committed by others.
